pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IERC20Like {
    function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);
}

contract WhitelistTransferManager {
    struct Lockup {
        uint256 amount;
        uint256 releaseTime;
    }

    error NotOwner();
    error NotOperator();
    error NotCallingContract();
    error AlreadyInitialized();
    error LengthMismatch();
    error ZeroAddress();
    error InvalidWallet();
    error InvalidValue();

    event OwnershipTransferred(address indexed previousOwner, address indexed newOwner);
    event OperatorAdded(address indexed account);
    event OperatorRemoved(address indexed account);

    event ApproveNewUser(address indexed wallet, uint256 indexed userId, address indexed operator);
    event AddApprovedUserWallet(address indexed wallet, address indexed approvedWallet, address indexed operator);
    event RevokeUserWallet(address indexed wallet, address indexed operator);

    event WalletActivated(address indexed wallet, address indexed operator);
    event WalletDeactivated(address indexed wallet, address indexed operator);

    event InvestorEnlisted(address indexed wallet, uint256 indexed userId);
    event InvestorDelisted(address indexed wallet, uint256 indexed userId);

    event UpdateJurisdictionForUserId(address indexed wallet, uint256 indexed jurisdiction, address indexed operator);
    event UpdateJurisdictionFlow(uint256 indexed fromJurisdiction, uint256 indexed toJurisdiction, uint256 value, address operator);

    event AddLockup(address indexed wallet, uint256 amount, uint256 releaseTime, address indexed operator);
    event UnlockTokens(address indexed wallet, uint256 amount, address indexed operator);

    event Halt(uint256 indexed jurisdiction, uint256 untilTimestamp);
    event Resume(uint256 indexed jurisdiction);

    event ConfigWhitelist(uint256 startDate, uint256 granularity, address indexed operator);
    event MaxInvestorsChanged(uint256 maxInvestors);
    event MaxInvestorsByJurisdictionChanged(uint256 indexed jurisdiction, uint256 maxInvestors);

    address private _owner;
    bool private _initialized;

    address private _callingContract;
    uint256 private _startDate;
    uint256 private _lockupGranularity = 1;

    uint256 private _maxInvestors;
    uint256 private _currentInvestors;

    mapping(address => bool) private _operators;

    mapping(address => uint256) private _walletToUserId;
    mapping(address => address) private _approvedWallet;
    mapping(address => address) private _revokedFrom;

    mapping(address => bool) private _walletActivated;
    mapping(address => bool) private _investorEnlisted;

    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _jurisdictionByUserId;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _activeWalletCountByUserId;

    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _maxInvestorsByJurisdiction;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _currentInvestorsByJurisdiction;
    mapping(uint256 => mapping(uint256 => uint256)) private _jurisdictionFlow;
    mapping(uint256 => uint256) private _jurisdictionHaltUntil;

    mapping(address => mapping(uint256 => Lockup)) private _lockups;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _lockupLength;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _lockupCursor;
    mapping(address => uint256) private _lockedTokenCount;

    modifier onlyOwner() {
        if (msg.sender != _owner) revert NotOwner();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyOperator() {
        if (!_operators[msg.sender]) revert NotOperator();
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyCallingContract() {
        if (msg.sender != _callingContract) revert NotCallingContract();
        _;
    }

    function initialize(address callingContract_) external {
        if (_initialized) revert AlreadyInitialized();
        _initialized = true;

        _transferOwnership(msg.sender);
        _operators[msg.sender] = true;
        emit OperatorAdded(msg.sender);

        _callingContract = callingContract_;
    }

    function owner() external view returns (address) {
        return _owner;
    }

    function isOwner() external view returns (bool) {
        return msg.sender == _owner;
    }

    function transferOwnership(address newOwner) external onlyOwner {
        if (newOwner == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
        _transferOwnership(newOwner);
    }

    function renounceOwnership() external onlyOwner {
        _transferOwnership(address(0));
    }

    function addOperator(address account) external onlyOwner {
        if (account == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
        _operators[account] = true;
        emit OperatorAdded(account);
    }

    function removeOperator(address account) external onlyOwner {
        _operators[account] = false;
        emit OperatorRemoved(account);
    }

    function renounceOperator() external {
        _operators[msg.sender] = false;
        emit OperatorRemoved(msg.sender);
    }

    function isOperator(address account) external view returns (bool) {
        return _operators[account];
    }

    function callingContract() external view returns (address) {
        return _callingContract;
    }

    function startDate() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _startDate;
    }

    function lockupGranularity() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _lockupGranularity;
    }

    function maxInvestors() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxInvestors;
    }

    function currentInvestors() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _currentInvestors;
    }

    function maxInvestorsByJurisdiction(uint256 jurisdiction) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _maxInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction];
    }

    function currentInvestorsByJurisdiction(uint256 jurisdiction) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction];
    }

    function investorEnlisted(address wallet) external view returns (bool) {
        return _investorEnlisted[wallet];
    }

    function walletActivated(address wallet) external view returns (bool) {
        return _walletActivated[wallet];
    }

    function revokedFrom(address wallet) external view returns (address) {
        return _revokedFrom[wallet];
    }

    function authorizedWalletToUserId(address wallet) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _walletToUserId[wallet];
    }

    function userActiveWalletCount(address wallet) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _activeWalletCountByUserId[_walletToUserId[wallet]];
    }

    function getJurisdictionFlow(uint256 fromJurisdiction, uint256 toJurisdiction) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _jurisdictionFlow[fromJurisdiction][toJurisdiction];
    }

    function jurisdictionHaltUntil(uint256 jurisdiction) external view returns (uint256) {
        return _jurisdictionHaltUntil[jurisdiction];
    }

    function setInvestorLimit(uint256 maxInvestors_) external onlyOwner {
        _maxInvestors = maxInvestors_;
        emit MaxInvestorsChanged(maxInvestors_);
    }

    function setInvestorLimitForJurisdiction(
        uint256[] calldata jurisdictions,
        uint256[] calldata limits
    ) external onlyOwner {
        if (jurisdictions.length != limits.length) revert LengthMismatch();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < jurisdictions.length; i++) {
            _maxInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdictions[i]] = limits[i];
            emit MaxInvestorsByJurisdictionChanged(jurisdictions[i], limits[i]);
        }
    }

    function configWhitelist(uint256 startDate_, uint256 granularity_) external onlyOwner {
        if (granularity_ == 0) revert InvalidValue();
        _startDate = startDate_;
        _lockupGranularity = granularity_;
        emit ConfigWhitelist(startDate_, granularity_, msg.sender);
    }

    function approveNewUsers(address[] calldata wallets, uint256[] calldata userIds) external onlyOperator {
        if (wallets.length != userIds.length) revert LengthMismatch();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            address wallet = wallets[i];
            uint256 userId = userIds[i];
            if (wallet == address(0) || userId == 0) revert InvalidValue();
            if (_walletToUserId[wallet] != 0) revert InvalidWallet();

            _walletToUserId[wallet] = userId;
            _approvedWallet[wallet] = wallet;

            if (!_walletActivated[wallet]) {
                _walletActivated[wallet] = true;
                _activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] += 1;
                emit WalletActivated(wallet, msg.sender);
            }

            emit ApproveNewUser(wallet, userId, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function addApprovedUserWallets(address[] calldata wallets, address[] calldata approvedWallets) external onlyOperator {
        if (wallets.length != approvedWallets.length) revert LengthMismatch();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            address wallet = wallets[i];
            address parent = approvedWallets[i];
            if (wallet == address(0) || parent == address(0)) revert ZeroAddress();
            if (_walletToUserId[wallet] != 0) revert InvalidWallet();

            uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[parent];
            if (userId == 0) revert InvalidWallet();

            _walletToUserId[wallet] = userId;
            _approvedWallet[wallet] = parent;

            if (!_walletActivated[wallet]) {
                _walletActivated[wallet] = true;
                _activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] += 1;
                emit WalletActivated(wallet, msg.sender);
            }

            emit AddApprovedUserWallet(wallet, parent, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function updateJurisdictionsForUserIds(address[] calldata wallets, uint256[] calldata jurisdictions) external onlyOperator {
        if (wallets.length != jurisdictions.length) revert LengthMismatch();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallets[i]];
            if (userId == 0) revert InvalidWallet();
            _jurisdictionByUserId[userId] = jurisdictions[i];
            emit UpdateJurisdictionForUserId(wallets[i], jurisdictions[i], msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function updateJurisdictionFlows(
        uint256[] calldata fromJurisdictions,
        uint256[] calldata toJurisdictions,
        uint256[] calldata values
    ) external onlyOwner {
        if (fromJurisdictions.length != toJurisdictions.length || fromJurisdictions.length != values.length) {
            revert LengthMismatch();
        }
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < fromJurisdictions.length; i++) {
            _jurisdictionFlow[fromJurisdictions[i]][toJurisdictions[i]] = values[i];
            emit UpdateJurisdictionFlow(fromJurisdictions[i], toJurisdictions[i], values[i], msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function halt(uint256[] calldata jurisdictions, uint256[] calldata untilTimestamps) external onlyOwner {
        if (jurisdictions.length != untilTimestamps.length) revert LengthMismatch();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < jurisdictions.length; i++) {
            if (untilTimestamps[i] <= block.timestamp) revert InvalidValue();
            _jurisdictionHaltUntil[jurisdictions[i]] = untilTimestamps[i];
            emit Halt(jurisdictions[i], untilTimestamps[i]);
        }
    }

    function resume(uint256[] calldata jurisdictions) external onlyOwner {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < jurisdictions.length; i++) {
            _jurisdictionHaltUntil[jurisdictions[i]] = 0;
            emit Resume(jurisdictions[i]);
        }
    }

    function enlistUsers(address[] calldata wallets) external onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            _activateWalletInternal(wallets[i], msg.sender);
            _enlistInvestorInternal(wallets[i]);
        }
    }

    function delistUsers(address[] calldata wallets) external onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            _delistInvestorInternal(wallets[i]);
            _deactivateWalletInternal(wallets[i], msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function activateWallets(address[] calldata wallets) external onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            _activateWalletInternal(wallets[i], msg.sender);
            _enlistInvestorInternal(wallets[i]);
        }
    }

    function deactivateWallets(address[] calldata wallets) external onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            _deactivateWalletInternal(wallets[i], msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function deactivateWallet(address wallet) external onlyOperator {
        _deactivateWalletInternal(wallet, msg.sender);
    }

    function revokeUserWallets(address[] calldata wallets) external onlyOperator {
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            address wallet = wallets[i];
            uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
            if (userId == 0) continue;

            _revokedFrom[wallet] = _approvedWallet[wallet];

            if (_walletActivated[wallet]) {
                _walletActivated[wallet] = false;
                if (_activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] > 0) {
                    _activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] -= 1;
                }
                emit WalletDeactivated(wallet, msg.sender);
            }

            delete _walletToUserId[wallet];
            delete _approvedWallet[wallet];

            emit RevokeUserWallet(wallet, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function addLockups(address[] calldata wallets, uint256[] calldata amounts, uint256[] calldata releaseTimes) external onlyOperator {
        if (wallets.length != amounts.length || wallets.length != releaseTimes.length) revert LengthMismatch();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < wallets.length; i++) {
            _addLockup(wallets[i], amounts[i], releaseTimes[i], msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function processLockups(address wallet, uint256 maxCount) external {
        _processLockupsInternal(wallet, maxCount, true, msg.sender);
    }

    function forceUnlockUpTo(address wallet, uint256 maxCount) external onlyOperator {
        _processLockupsInternal(wallet, maxCount, false, msg.sender);
    }

    function getUserIdLockup(address wallet, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256 amount, uint256 releaseTime) {
        Lockup storage l = _lockups[wallet][index];
        return (l.amount, l.releaseTime);
    }

    function getLockedTokenCount(address wallet) public view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 total = _lockedTokenCount[wallet];
        if (total == 0) return 0;

        uint256 cursor = _lockupCursor[wallet];
        uint256 len = _lockupLength[wallet];
        for (uint256 i = cursor; i < len; i++) {
            Lockup storage l = _lockups[wallet][i];
            if (l.amount == 0) continue;
            if (l.releaseTime <= block.timestamp) {
                if (l.amount >= total) return 0;
                total -= l.amount;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    function getAuthorizedUserIdInfo(address wallet)
        external
        view
        returns (uint256 userId, uint256 jurisdiction, uint256 activeWallets, uint256 lockedTokens)
    {
        userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        jurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[userId];
        activeWallets = _activeWalletCountByUserId[userId];
        lockedTokens = getLockedTokenCount(wallet);
    }

    function detectTransferRestriction(address from, address to, uint256 amount) public view returns (uint8) {
        if (_startDate != 0 && block.timestamp < _startDate) return 3;

        uint256 fromUserId = from == address(0) ? 0 : _walletToUserId[from];
        uint256 toUserId = to == address(0) ? 0 : _walletToUserId[to];

        if (from != address(0) && (!_walletActivated[from] || fromUserId == 0 || !_investorEnlisted[from])) return 3;
        if (to != address(0) && (!_walletActivated[to] || toUserId == 0)) return 3;

        uint256 fromJurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[fromUserId];
        uint256 toJurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[toUserId];

        if (from != address(0) && _jurisdictionHaltUntil[fromJurisdiction] > block.timestamp) return 4;
        if (to != address(0) && _jurisdictionHaltUntil[toJurisdiction] > block.timestamp) return 4;

        if (from != address(0) && to != address(0) && fromJurisdiction != toJurisdiction) {
            uint256 flowLimit = _jurisdictionFlow[fromJurisdiction][toJurisdiction];
            if (flowLimit == 0 || amount > flowLimit) return 1;
        }

        if (from != address(0)) {
            uint256 bal = _balanceOf(from);
            uint256 locked = getLockedTokenCount(from);
            if (bal < amount) return 2;
            if (bal - amount < locked) return 2;
        }

        return 0;
    }

    function messageForTransferRestriction(uint8 code) external pure returns (string memory) {
        if (code == 0) return "SUCCESS";
        if (code == 1) return "DENIED: JURISDICTION_FLOW";
        if (code == 2) return "DENIED: LOCKUP";
        if (code == 3) return "DENIED: NOT_AUTHORIZED";
        if (code == 4) return "DENIED: JURISDICTION_HALT";
        return "DENIED";
    }

    function authorizeTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount, bool bypass) external onlyCallingContract {
        if (bypass) return;
        uint8 code = detectTransferRestriction(from, to, amount);
        if (code != 0) revert(messageForTransferRestriction(code));
        if (from != address(0)) {
            _processLockupsInternal(from, type(uint256).max, true, msg.sender);
        }
    }

    function _addLockup(address wallet, uint256 amount, uint256 releaseTime, address operator_) internal {
        if (wallet == address(0) || amount == 0) revert InvalidValue();
        if (_lockupGranularity != 0 && amount % _lockupGranularity != 0) revert InvalidValue();
        if (releaseTime != 0 && releaseTime <= block.timestamp) revert InvalidValue();

        uint256 idx = _lockupLength[wallet];
        _lockups[wallet][idx] = Lockup(amount, releaseTime);
        _lockupLength[wallet] = idx + 1;
        _lockedTokenCount[wallet] += amount;

        emit AddLockup(wallet, amount, releaseTime, operator_);
    }

    function _processLockupsInternal(address wallet, uint256 maxCount, bool maturedOnly, address operator_) internal {
        uint256 cursor = _lockupCursor[wallet];
        uint256 len = _lockupLength[wallet];
        uint256 processed;

        while (cursor < len && processed < maxCount) {
            Lockup storage l = _lockups[wallet][cursor];

            if (maturedOnly && l.releaseTime > block.timestamp) break;

            if (l.amount > 0) {
                uint256 amount = l.amount;
                l.amount = 0;
                if (_lockedTokenCount[wallet] >= amount) {
                    _lockedTokenCount[wallet] -= amount;
                } else {
                    _lockedTokenCount[wallet] = 0;
                }
                emit UnlockTokens(wallet, amount, operator_);
            }

            cursor++;
            processed++;
        }

        _lockupCursor[wallet] = cursor;
    }

    function _activateWalletInternal(address wallet, address operator_) internal {
        uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        if (wallet == address(0) || userId == 0) revert InvalidWallet();

        if (!_walletActivated[wallet]) {
            _walletActivated[wallet] = true;
            _activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] += 1;
            emit WalletActivated(wallet, operator_);
        }
    }

    function _deactivateWalletInternal(address wallet, address operator_) internal {
        uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        if (wallet == address(0) || userId == 0) return;

        if (_walletActivated[wallet]) {
            _walletActivated[wallet] = false;
            if (_activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] > 0) {
                _activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] -= 1;
            }
            emit WalletDeactivated(wallet, operator_);
        }

        if (_activeWalletCountByUserId[userId] == 0 && _investorEnlisted[wallet]) {
            _delistInvestorInternal(wallet);
        }
    }

    function _enlistInvestorInternal(address wallet) internal {
        uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        if (userId == 0) revert InvalidWallet();
        if (_investorEnlisted[wallet]) return;

        uint256 jurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[userId];

        if (_maxInvestors != 0) {
            require(_currentInvestors + 1 <= _maxInvestors, "EXCEEDING_MAX_INVESTORS");
        }

        uint256 maxByJ = _maxInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction];
        if (maxByJ != 0) {
            require(
                _currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] + 1 <= maxByJ,
                "EXCEEDING_MAX_INVESTORS_BY_JURISDICTION"
            );
        }

        _investorEnlisted[wallet] = true;
        _currentInvestors += 1;
        _currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] += 1;

        emit InvestorEnlisted(wallet, userId);
    }

    function _delistInvestorInternal(address wallet) internal {
        if (!_investorEnlisted[wallet]) return;

        uint256 userId = _walletToUserId[wallet];
        uint256 jurisdiction = _jurisdictionByUserId[userId];

        _investorEnlisted[wallet] = false;
        if (_currentInvestors > 0) _currentInvestors -= 1;
        if (_currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] > 0) {
            _currentInvestorsByJurisdiction[jurisdiction] -= 1;
        }

        emit InvestorDelisted(wallet, userId);
    }

    function _balanceOf(address account) internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_callingContract == address(0)) return type(uint256).max;
        try IERC20Like(_callingContract).balanceOf(account) returns (uint256 bal) {
            return bal;
        } catch {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal {
        address old = _owner;
        _owner = newOwner;
        emit OwnershipTransferred(old, newOwner);
    }

    receive() external payable {
        revert();
    }

    fallback() external payable {
        revert();
    }
}

pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

interface IERC1822Proxiable {
    function proxiableUUID() external view returns (bytes32);
}

contract StakefishPoolV3 {
    event ValidatorParted(bytes indexed validatorPubKey, address indexed depositor, uint256 timestamp);
    event OperatorChanged(address newOperator);
    event CommissionRateChanged(uint256 newRateBasisPoints);
    event CommissionCollected(address to, uint256 amount);
    event ValidatorRewardCollected(address indexed depositor, address to, uint256 amount, address caller);
    event ValidatorTransferred(bytes indexed validatorPubKey, address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 timestamp);
    event Upgraded(address indexed implementation);
    event Initialized(uint8 version);

    struct UserState {
        uint256 validatorCount;
        uint256 rewardDebt;      // scaled by 1e6
        uint256 pendingReward;
        uint256 claimedHistory;
    }

    struct ValidatorInfo {
        address depositor;
        uint32 joinedAt;
    }

    uint256 private constant SCALE = 1_000_000;
    uint256 private constant NOT_ENTERED = 1;
    uint256 private constant ENTERED = 2;

    bytes32 private constant _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT =
        0x360894A13BA1A3210667C828492DB98DCA3E2076CC3735A920A3CA505D382BBC;

    address private immutable __self;

    address private _admin;       // stakefish admin
    address private _operator;    // stakefish operator

    uint256 private _totalValidators;
    uint256 private _stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints;
    uint256 private _lifetimeCollectedCommission;
    uint256 private _lifetimePaidUserRewards;
    bool private _openForWithdrawal;

    uint256 private _amountTransferredToColdWallet;
    uint256 private _accRewardPerValidator;      // scaled by 1e6
    uint256 private _lastRewardUpdateBlock;
    uint256 private _lifetimeRewardCheckpoint;

    uint256 private _status;
    bool private _initialized;

    mapping(address => UserState) private _users;
    mapping(bytes32 => ValidatorInfo) private _validators; // keccak256(pubkey) => info

    constructor() {
        __self = address(this);
        _status = NOT_ENTERED;
    }

    modifier onlyAdmin() {
        require(msg.sender == _admin, "Only stakefish admin allowed");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyOperator() {
        require(msg.sender == _operator, "Only stakefish operator allowed");
        _;
    }

    modifier nonReentrant() {
        require(_status != ENTERED, "ReentrancyGuard: reentrant call");
        _status = ENTERED;
        _;
        _status = NOT_ENTERED;
    }

    modifier onlyProxy() {
        require(address(this) != __self, "Function must be called through delegatecall");
        require(_getImplementation() == __self, "Function must be called through active proxy");
        _;
    }

    modifier notDelegated() {
        require(address(this) == __self, "UUPSUpgradeable: must not be called through delegatecall");
        _;
    }

    receive() external payable {}
    fallback() external payable {}

    function initialize(address admin_, address operator_) external {
        require(!_initialized, "Initializable: contract is already initialized");
        require(admin_ != address(0), "admin must be set");
        require(operator_ != address(0), "operator must be set");

        _initialized = true;
        if (_status == 0) _status = NOT_ENTERED;

        _admin = admin_;
        _operator = operator_;
        _stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints = 2000;
        _openForWithdrawal = true;

        _lastRewardUpdateBlock = block.number;
        _lifetimeRewardCheckpoint = _lifetimeReward();

        emit Initialized(1);
    }

    function initialize_version3() external {
        if (!_initialized) {
            _initialized = true;
            if (_status == 0) _status = NOT_ENTERED;
            emit Initialized(1);
        }
        _amountTransferredToColdWallet = 0;
    }

    function changeOperator(address newOperator) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(newOperator != address(0), "operator must be set");
        _operator = newOperator;
        emit OperatorChanged(newOperator);
    }

    function setCommissionRate(uint256 newRateBasisPoints) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        _updateGlobal();
        _stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints = newRateBasisPoints;
        emit CommissionRateChanged(newRateBasisPoints);
    }

    function openPoolForWithdrawal() external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(!_openForWithdrawal, "Pool is already open for withdrawal");
        _openForWithdrawal = true;
    }

    function closePoolForWithdrawal() external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(_openForWithdrawal, "Pool is already closed for withdrawal");
        _openForWithdrawal = false;
    }

    function saveToColdWallet(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(address(this).balance >= amount, "Not enough balance");
        _amountTransferredToColdWallet += amount;
        _sendValue(to, amount);
    }

    function loadFromColdWallet() external payable onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(msg.value <= _amountTransferredToColdWallet, "Too much transferred from cold wallet");
        _amountTransferredToColdWallet -= msg.value;
    }

    function collectPoolCommission(address to, uint256 amount) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(to != address(0), "to address must be set to nonzero");
        _updateGlobal();

        uint256 pending = _pendingCommission();
        if (amount == 0) amount = pending;
        require(amount <= pending, "Not enough pending commission");

        _lifetimeCollectedCommission += amount;
        emit CommissionCollected(to, amount);
        _sendValue(to, amount);
    }

    function collectReward(address to, uint256 amount) external nonReentrant {
        require(_openForWithdrawal, "Pool is not open for withdrawal right now");
        _updateGlobal();
        _collectRewardFor(msg.sender, to, amount);
    }

    function emergencyWithdraw(
        address[] calldata beneficiaries,
        address[] calldata tos,
        uint256 amountPerBeneficiary
    ) external onlyAdmin nonReentrant {
        require(
            tos.length == 1 || tos.length == beneficiaries.length,
            "beneficiaries length incorrect"
        );
        _updateGlobal();

        if (tos.length == 1) {
            address to = tos[0];
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < beneficiaries.length; i++) {
                _collectRewardFor(beneficiaries[i], to, amountPerBeneficiary);
            }
        } else {
            for (uint256 i = 0; i < beneficiaries.length; i++) {
                _collectRewardFor(beneficiaries[i], tos[i], amountPerBeneficiary);
            }
        }
    }

    function migrateFromV2(address[] calldata depositors) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        require(!_openForWithdrawal, "Pool must be closed for withdrawal");
        _updateGlobal();

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositors.length; i++) {
            address d = depositors[i];
            if (d == address(0)) continue;

            _settle(d);
            _users[d].validatorCount += 1;
            _users[d].rewardDebt = _accRewardPerValidator;
            _totalValidators += 1;
        }
    }

    function transferClaimHistory(address[] calldata depositors, uint256[] calldata amounts) external onlyAdmin {
        require(depositors.length == amounts.length, "length mismatch");
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < depositors.length; i++) {
            _users[depositors[i]].claimedHistory += amounts[i];
            _lifetimePaidUserRewards += amounts[i];
        }
    }

    function joinPool(bytes calldata validatorPubKey, address depositor) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        _updateGlobal();
        bytes memory pk = validatorPubKey;
        _join(pk, depositor, block.timestamp);
    }

    function joinPool(
        bytes calldata validatorPubKey,
        address depositor,
        uint256 joinedAtHint
    ) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        _updateGlobal();
        bytes memory pk = validatorPubKey;
        _join(pk, depositor, joinedAtHint == 0 ? block.timestamp : joinedAtHint);
    }

    function bulkJoinPool(
        bytes calldata validatorPubKeys,
        address[] calldata depositors,
        uint256 mode
    ) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        uint256 n = _validatorCountFromBytes(validatorPubKeys, "pubKeyArray length not multiple of 48");
        if (mode == 1) {
            require(depositors.length == 1, "Invalid depositorAddresses length");
        } else {
            require(depositors.length == n, "Invalid depositorAddresses length");
        }

        _updateGlobal();

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            address d = mode == 1 ? depositors[0] : depositors[i];
            bytes memory pk = _slice48(validatorPubKeys, i);
            _join(pk, d, block.timestamp);
        }
    }

    function partPool(bytes calldata validatorPubKey) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        _updateGlobal();
        bytes memory pk = validatorPubKey;
        _part(pk, block.timestamp);
    }

    function partPool(bytes calldata validatorPubKey, uint256 timestampHint) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        _updateGlobal();
        bytes memory pk = validatorPubKey;
        _part(pk, timestampHint == 0 ? block.timestamp : timestampHint);
    }

    function bulkPartPool(bytes calldata validatorPubKeys, uint256 timestampHint) external onlyOperator nonReentrant {
        uint256 n = _validatorCountFromBytes(validatorPubKeys, "pubKeyArray length not multiple of 48");
        _updateGlobal();

        uint256 ts = timestampHint == 0 ? block.timestamp : timestampHint;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            bytes memory pk = _slice48(validatorPubKeys, i);
            _part(pk, ts);
        }
    }

    function transferValidatorByAdmin(bytes calldata validatorPubKeys, address[] calldata newDepositors)
        external
        onlyAdmin
        nonReentrant
    {
        uint256 n = _validatorCountFromBytes(validatorPubKeys, "validatorPubkeys byte array length incorrect");
        require(n == newDepositors.length, "validatorPubkeys byte array length incorrect");

        _updateGlobal();
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            bytes memory pk = _slice48(validatorPubKeys, i);
            _transferValidator(pk, newDepositors[i]);
        }
    }

    function totalValidators() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _totalValidators;
    }

    function stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints;
    }

    function lifetimeCollectedCommission() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _lifetimeCollectedCommission;
    }

    function lifetimePaidUserRewards() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _lifetimePaidUserRewards;
    }

    function amountTransferredToColdWallet() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _amountTransferredToColdWallet;
    }

    function isOpenForWithdrawal() external view returns (bool) {
        return _openForWithdrawal;
    }

    function getLifetimeReward() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _lifetimeReward();
    }

    function getAccRewardPerValidator() public view returns (uint256) {
        return _currentAccRewardPerValidator();
    }

    function getPoolState()
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 accRewardPerValidator_,
            uint256 totalValidators_,
            uint256 commissionRateBps_,
            uint256 pendingPoolCommission_,
            uint256 lifetimeCommission_,
            uint256 lifetimePaidRewards_,
            bool openForWithdrawal_
        )
    {
        accRewardPerValidator_ = _currentAccRewardPerValidator();
        totalValidators_ = _totalValidators;
        commissionRateBps_ = _stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints;
        pendingPoolCommission_ = _pendingCommissionView();
        lifetimeCommission_ = _lifetimeCollectedCommission;
        lifetimePaidRewards_ = _lifetimePaidUserRewards;
        openForWithdrawal_ = _openForWithdrawal;
    }

    function getUserState(address depositor)
        external
        view
        returns (
            uint256 validatorCount_,
            uint256 pendingReward_,
            uint256 claimedHistory_,
            uint256 rewardDebt_
        )
    {
        UserState storage u = _users[depositor];
        validatorCount_ = u.validatorCount;
        pendingReward_ = _pendingRewardOf(depositor);
        claimedHistory_ = u.claimedHistory;
        rewardDebt_ = u.rewardDebt;
    }

    function pendingReward(address depositor) external view returns (uint256 pending, uint256 validatorCount_) {
        pending = _pendingRewardOf(depositor);
        validatorCount_ = _users[depositor].validatorCount;
    }

    function decodeValidatorInfo(uint256 packed) external pure returns (address depositor, uint256 joinedAt) {
        depositor = address(uint160(packed));
        joinedAt = packed >> 224;
    }

    function encodeValidatorInfo(address depositor, uint256 joinedAt) external pure returns (uint256) {
        return (uint256(uint32(joinedAt)) << 224) | uint256(uint160(depositor));
    }

    function proxiableUUID() external view notDelegated returns (bytes32) {
        return _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT;
    }

    function upgradeTo(address newImplementation) external onlyProxy onlyAdmin {
        _upgradeToAndCallUUPS(newImplementation, bytes(""), false);
    }

    function upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes calldata data)
        external
        payable
        onlyProxy
        onlyAdmin
    {
        _upgradeToAndCallUUPS(newImplementation, data, true);
    }

    function _join(bytes memory validatorPubKey, address depositor, uint256 timestamp_) internal {
        require(validatorPubKey.length == 48, "validatorPubkeys byte array length incorrect");
        require(depositor != address(0), "depositorAddress must be set");

        bytes32 key = keccak256(validatorPubKey);
        require(_validators[key].depositor == address(0), "Validator already in pool");

        _settle(depositor);
        _users[depositor].validatorCount += 1;
        _users[depositor].rewardDebt = _accRewardPerValidator;
        _totalValidators += 1;

        _validators[key] = ValidatorInfo({depositor: depositor, joinedAt: uint32(timestamp_)});
        emit ValidatorParted(validatorPubKey, depositor, timestamp_);
    }

    function _part(bytes memory validatorPubKey, uint256 timestamp_) internal {
        require(validatorPubKey.length == 48, "validatorPubkeys byte array length incorrect");
        bytes32 key = keccak256(validatorPubKey);

        ValidatorInfo storage v = _validators[key];
        address depositor = v.depositor;
        require(depositor != address(0), "validator not in pool");

        _settle(depositor);

        if (_users[depositor].validatorCount > 0) {
            _users[depositor].validatorCount -= 1;
        }
        _users[depositor].rewardDebt = _accRewardPerValidator;

        if (_totalValidators > 0) _totalValidators -= 1;
        delete _validators[key];

        emit ValidatorParted(validatorPubKey, depositor, timestamp_);
    }

    function _transferValidator(bytes memory validatorPubKey, address to) internal {
        require(validatorPubKey.length == 48, "validatorPubkeys byte array length incorrect");
        require(to != address(0), "to address must be set to nonzero");

        bytes32 key = keccak256(validatorPubKey);
        ValidatorInfo storage v = _validators[key];
        address from = v.depositor;
        require(from != address(0), "validator not in pool");
        require(from != to, "cannot transfer validator owner to same");

        _settle(from);
        if (_users[from].validatorCount > 0) {
            _users[from].validatorCount -= 1;
        }
        _users[from].rewardDebt = _accRewardPerValidator;

        _settle(to);
        _users[to].validatorCount += 1;
        _users[to].rewardDebt = _accRewardPerValidator;

        v.depositor = to;
        emit ValidatorTransferred(validatorPubKey, from, to, block.timestamp);
    }

    function _collectRewardFor(address depositor, address to, uint256 amount) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "to address must be set to nonzero");

        _settle(depositor);

        uint256 available = _users[depositor].pendingReward;
        if (amount == 0) amount = available;
        require(amount <= available, "Not enough pending rewards");

        _users[depositor].pendingReward = available - amount;
        _users[depositor].claimedHistory += amount;
        _lifetimePaidUserRewards += amount;

        emit ValidatorRewardCollected(depositor, to, amount, msg.sender);
        _sendValue(to, amount);
    }

    function _lifetimeReward() internal view returns (uint256) {
        return address(this).balance + _amountTransferredToColdWallet + _lifetimePaidUserRewards + _lifetimeCollectedCommission;
    }

    function _currentAccRewardPerValidator() internal view returns (uint256) {
        if (_totalValidators == 0) return _accRewardPerValidator;
        return (_lifetimeReward() * SCALE) / _totalValidators;
    }

    function _updateGlobal() internal {
        if (block.number > _lastRewardUpdateBlock && _totalValidators != 0) {
            _accRewardPerValidator = _currentAccRewardPerValidator();
            _lifetimeRewardCheckpoint = _lifetimeReward();
        }
        _lastRewardUpdateBlock = block.number;
    }

    function _settle(address depositor) internal {
        UserState storage u = _users[depositor];
        if (u.validatorCount != 0 && _accRewardPerValidator > u.rewardDebt) {
            uint256 delta = _accRewardPerValidator - u.rewardDebt;
            u.pendingReward += (u.validatorCount * delta) / SCALE;
        }
        u.rewardDebt = _accRewardPerValidator;
    }

    function _pendingRewardOf(address depositor) internal view returns (uint256) {
        UserState storage u = _users[depositor];
        uint256 pending = u.pendingReward;
        uint256 accNow = _currentAccRewardPerValidator();
        if (u.validatorCount != 0 && accNow > u.rewardDebt) {
            pending += (u.validatorCount * (accNow - u.rewardDebt)) / SCALE;
        }
        return pending;
    }

    function _pendingCommissionView() internal view returns (uint256) {
        uint256 entitled = (_lifetimeReward() * _stakefishCommissionRateBasisPoints) / 10_000;
        if (entitled <= _lifetimeCollectedCommission) return 0;
        return entitled - _lifetimeCollectedCommission;
    }

    function _pendingCommission() internal view returns (uint256) {
        return _pendingCommissionView();
    }

    function _validatorCountFromBytes(bytes calldata blob, string memory err) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        require(blob.length % 48 == 0, err);
        return blob.length / 48;
    }

    function _slice48(bytes calldata blob, uint256 idx) internal pure returns (bytes memory out) {
        uint256 start = idx * 48;
        out = new bytes(48);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 48; i++) {
            out[i] = blob[start + i];
        }
    }

    function _sendValue(address to, uint256 value) internal {
        require(address(this).balance >= value, "Address: insufficient balance");
        (bool success, ) = payable(to).call{value: value}("");
        require(success, "Address: unable to send value, recipient may have reverted");
    }

    function _getImplementation() internal view returns (address impl) {
        bytes32 slot = _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT;
        assembly {
            impl := sload(slot)
        }
    }

    function _setImplementation(address newImplementation) private {
        require(_isContract(newImplementation), "ERC1967: new implementation is not a contract");
        bytes32 slot = _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT;
        assembly {
            sstore(slot, newImplementation)
        }
    }

    function _upgradeToAndCallUUPS(address newImplementation, bytes memory data, bool forceCall) internal {
        try IERC1822Proxiable(newImplementation).proxiableUUID() returns (bytes32 slot) {
            require(slot == _IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT, "ERC1967Upgrade: unsupported proxiableUUID");
        } catch {
            revert("ERC1967Upgrade: new implementation is not UUPS");
        }

        _setImplementation(newImplementation);
        emit Upgraded(newImplementation);

        if (data.length > 0 || forceCall) {
            _functionDelegateCall(newImplementation, data);
        }
    }

    function _functionDelegateCall(address target, bytes memory data) internal returns (bytes memory) {
        require(_isContract(target), "Address: delegate call to non-contract");
        (bool success, bytes memory returndata) = target.delegatecall(data);
        if (success) return returndata;

        if (returndata.length > 0) {
            assembly {
                revert(add(returndata, 32), mload(returndata))
            }
        }
        revert("Address: low-level delegate call failed");
    }

    function _isContract(address account) internal view returns (bool) {
        return account.code.length > 0;
    }
}

    ) external onlyOwnerOrAuthorised {
        require(recipients.length == tokenIds.length, "NFTBoxes: Wrong array size.");

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < tokenIds.length; i++) {
            _requireMinted(tokenIds[i]);
            require(_boxesData[tokenIds[i]].mouldId == mouldId, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");

            if (_vendingMachine.code.length > 0) {
                for (uint256 j = 0; j < recipients[i].length; j++) {
                    INFTMachine(_vendingMachine).NFTMachineFor(tokenIds[i], recipients[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        emit BatchDeployed(mouldId, tokenIds.length);
    }

    function boxes(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (uint256 mouldId, uint256 paidPrice) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        BoxData storage b = _boxesData[tokenId];
        return (b.mouldId, b.paidPrice);
    }

    function lockedBoxes(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (bool) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        return _boxesData[tokenId].locked;
    }

    function getBoxMetaData(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (BoxMetaData memory meta) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        BoxData storage b = _boxesData[tokenId];

        meta.tokenId = tokenId;
        meta.mouldId = b.mouldId;
        meta.paidPrice = b.paidPrice;
        meta.locked = b.locked;
        meta.distributed = b.distributed;
        meta.mould = _readMould(b.mouldId);
    }

    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {
        require(account != address(0), "ERC721: balance query for the zero address");
        return _balances[account];
    }

    function ownerOf(uint256 tokenId) public view returns (address) {
        address o = _owners[tokenId];
        require(o != address(0), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token");
        return o;
    }

    function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256) {
        return _allTokens.length;
    }

    function tokenByIndex(uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _allTokens.length, "EnumerableMap: index out of bounds");
        return _allTokens[index];
    }

    function tokenOfOwnerByIndex(address account, uint256 index) external view returns (uint256) {
        require(index < _ownedTokens[account].length, "EnumerableMap: index out of bounds");
        return _ownedTokens[account][index];
    }

    function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string memory) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);

        string memory direct = _tokenURIs[tokenId];
        if (bytes(direct).length != 0) {
            return direct;
        }

        if (bytes(_baseURIValue).length == 0) {
            return "";
        }

        return string(abi.encodePacked(_baseURIValue, _toString(tokenId)));
    }

    function approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        require(to != tokenOwner, "ERC721: approval to current owner");
        require(
            msg.sender == tokenOwner || isApprovedForAll(tokenOwner, msg.sender),
            "ERC721: approve caller is not owner nor approved for all"
        );
        _approve(to, tokenId);
    }

    function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (address) {
        _requireMinted(tokenId);
        return _tokenApprovals[tokenId];
    }

    function setApprovalForAll(address operator, bool approved) external {
        require(operator != msg.sender, "ERC721: approve to caller");
        _operatorApprovals[msg.sender][operator] = approved;
        emit ApprovalForAll(msg.sender, operator, approved);
    }

    function isApprovedForAll(address tokenOwner, address operator) public view returns (bool) {
        return _operatorApprovals[tokenOwner][operator];
    }

    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) public {
        require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), "ERC721: transfer caller is not owner nor approved");
        require(ownerOf(tokenId) == from, "ERC721: transfer from incorrect owner");
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: transfer to the zero address");

        _approve(address(0), tokenId);

        _balances[from] -= 1;
        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(from, tokenId);
        _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);

        emit Transfer(from, to, tokenId);
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId) external {
        safeTransferFrom(from, to, tokenId, "");
    }

    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) public {
        transferFrom(from, to, tokenId);
        require(_checkOnERC721Received(from, to, tokenId, data), "ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
    }

    function _mint(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        require(to != address(0), "ERC721: mint to the zero address");
        require(!_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: token already minted");

        _balances[to] += 1;
        _owners[tokenId] = to;

        _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(to, tokenId);
        _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(tokenId);

        emit Transfer(address(0), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _payoutForToken(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        BoxData storage b = _boxesData[tokenId];
        uint256 gross = b.paidPrice;
        if (gross == 0) {
            gross = uint256(_moulds[b.mouldId].price);
        }

        require(address(this).balance >= gross, "NFTBoxes: Wrong total price.");

        (address[] memory recipients, uint256[] memory bps) = _royaltiesForMould(b.mouldId);

        uint256 sent;
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < recipients.length; i++) {
            if (recipients[i] == address(0) || bps[i] == 0) continue;
            uint256 amount = (gross * bps[i]) / TOTAL_SHARES;
            if (amount == 0) continue;
            sent += amount;
            _sendValue(payable(recipients[i]), amount);
        }

        if (gross > sent && _teamAddress != address(0)) {
            _sendValue(payable(_teamAddress), gross - sent);
        }
    }

    function _sendValue(address payable to, uint256 value) internal {
        (bool ok, ) = to.call{value: value}("");
        require(ok, "Address: call to non-contract");
    }

    function _royaltiesForMould(uint256 mouldId) internal view returns (address[] memory recipients, uint256[] memory bps) {
        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");

        recipients = new address[](m.artists.length + 1);
        bps = new uint256[](m.artistShares.length + 1);

        recipients[0] = _teamAddress;
        bps[0] = _secondaryFeeBps;

        for (uint256 i = 0; i < m.artists.length; i++) {
            recipients[i + 1] = m.artists[i];
            bps[i + 1] = m.artistShares[i];
        }
    }

    function _readMould(uint256 mouldId) internal view returns (BoxMould memory out) {
        BoxMould storage m = _moulds[mouldId];
        require(m.exists, "NFTBoxes: Mould ID does not exist");

        out.exists = m.exists;
        out.feeA = m.feeA;
        out.feeB = m.feeB;
        out.price = m.price;
        out.maxPerBuy = m.maxPerBuy;
        out.maxSupply = m.maxSupply;
        out.sold = m.sold;
        out.artists = _copyAddresses(m.artists);
        out.artistShares = _copyUints(m.artistShares);
        out.data0 = m.data0;
        out.data1 = m.data1;
        out.data2 = m.data2;
        out.data3 = m.data3;
        out.data4 = m.data4;
    }

    function _copyAddresses(address[] storage src) internal view returns (address[] memory dst) {
        dst = new address[](src.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
            dst[i] = src[i];
        }
    }

    function _copyUints(uint256[] storage src) internal view returns (uint256[] memory dst) {
        dst = new uint256[](src.length);
        for (uint256 i = 0; i < src.length; i++) {
            dst[i] = src[i];
        }
    }

    function _exists(uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        return _owners[tokenId] != address(0);
    }

    function _requireMinted(uint256 tokenId) internal view {
        require(_exists(tokenId), "ERC721: owner query for nonexistent token");
    }

    function _approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _tokenApprovals[tokenId] = to;
        emit Approval(ownerOf(tokenId), to, tokenId);
    }

    function _isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) internal view returns (bool) {
        address tokenOwner = ownerOf(tokenId);
        return (spender == tokenOwner || isApprovedForAll(tokenOwner, spender) || _tokenApprovals[tokenId] == spender);
    }

    function _addTokenToOwnerEnumeration(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId] = _ownedTokens[to].length;
        _ownedTokens[to].push(tokenId);
    }

    function _removeTokenFromOwnerEnumeration(address from, uint256 tokenId) internal {
        uint256 lastTokenIndex = _ownedTokens[from].length - 1;
        uint256 tokenIndex = _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];

        if (tokenIndex != lastTokenIndex) {
            uint256 lastTokenId = _ownedTokens[from][lastTokenIndex];
            _ownedTokens[from][tokenIndex] = lastTokenId;
            _ownedTokensIndex[lastTokenId] = tokenIndex;
        }

        _ownedTokens[from].pop();
        delete _ownedTokensIndex[tokenId];
    }

    function _addTokenToAllTokensEnumeration(uint256 tokenId) internal {
        _allTokensIndex[tokenId] = _allTokens.length;
        _allTokens.push(tokenId);
    }

    function _checkOnERC721Received(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes memory data) private returns (bool) {
        if (to.code.length == 0) return true;

        try IERC721Receiver(to).onERC721Received(msg.sender, from, tokenId, data) returns (bytes4 retval) {
            return retval == IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received.selector;
        } catch (bytes memory reason) {
            if (reason.length == 0) {
                revert("ERC721: transfer to non ERC721Receiver implementer");
            }
            assembly {
                revert(add(reason, 32), mload(reason))
            }
        }
    }

    function _toString(uint256 value) internal pure returns (string memory str) {
        if (value == 0) return "0";
        uint256 temp = value;
        uint256 digits;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits++;
            temp /= 10;
        }
        bytes memory buffer = new bytes(digits);
        uint256 i = digits;
        temp = value;
        while (temp != 0) {
            i--;
            buffer[i] = bytes1(uint8(48 + (temp % 10)));
            temp /= 10;
        }
        str = string(buffer);
    }
}
